from legacy_code using codes.csv. Then run ./run-migration.sh to apply it to the

echo "apply migration to staging" >> .effects.log

arguments.content:
-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv.

ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
  ELSE NULL
END;
